2. New inherited lookups stay at **15 until the next day**, when **20** becomes effective. Existing orders keep their snapshots. (§ “Preparation updates”)
3. The current increment delivers lookup and order snapshot work. Further implementation detail is not provided. (§ “Preparation updates”)
4. Scheduling is excluded. (§ “Preparation updates”)
